ladder.label: UNCONFIRMED TURN
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup is forming (swing low in, momentum turned up) — but the higher timeframes haven't confirmed it: the bigger picture is still bearish (weekly momentum just crossed down). This is an UNCONFIRMED TURN, not a confirmed buy. Weekly confirmation lags price, so this exact reading covers BOTH bounces that fail AND the first leg of a genuine new cycle — you can't tell which in real time, so treat it as a risk/size signal, not a direction call. Measured: weekly-unconfirmed bottoming setups held the low ~49% of the time vs ~68% once the weekly turns up.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 94.14. Not an investment buy yet. What would upgrade it: weekly momentum turning up, a reclaim of the investor-cycle low, or the first daily cycle right-translating — add on confirmation, not ahead of it.
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum just crossed down (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle day 33).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): unconfirmed turn. Bigger picture (counter-trend): bearish.
points: Bigger picture is bearish (counter-trend for a daily long)

entry.text: An unconfirmed turn: a daily low is forming while the bigger picture is still bearish. Nimble traders only — small size, defined stop below 94.14. Not an investment buy until the weekly confirms; most of these fail, a minority start a new cycle.
entry.text_zh: 未确认转向：日线低点正在形成，但大局仍偏空。仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 94.14 下方。在周线确认前并非投资性买入；多数最终失败，少数则开启新周期。

cycle_plain.weekly_line: Weekly (investor) cycle: week 12 of a typical 16–26 weeks

cycle_plain.weekly_phase_zh: 中期——更大的上行段正在成熟
cycle_plain.translation: The last cycle peaked in its SECOND half ('right-translated') — strong cycles top late, a healthy-uptrend sign.
cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 正在形成日线筑底形态（摆动低点已现、动量转向上行）——但更高周期尚未确认：大局仍偏空（周线动量刚刚向下交叉）。这是「未确认转向」，并非已确认的买入。周线确认滞后于价格，因此同样的读数既涵盖最终失败的反弹，也涵盖真正新周期的第一段——实时无法判定属于哪一种，故应将其视为风险/仓位信号，而非方向判断。实测：周线未确认的筑底形态约 49% 守住低点，周线转向后升至约 68%。
ladder.next_zh: 仅限灵活交易者——小仓位、止损设于 94.14 下方。暂非投资性买入。何种情形会升级：周线动量转为向上、收复投资者周期低点、或首个日线周期呈右移结构——在确认之后加仓，而非提前。
ladder.regime_line_zh: 大局：看空 — 周线动量刚刚向下交叉（投资者周期第 12 周 · 日线周期第 33 天）。
ladder.summary_line_zh: 短期（日线）：未确认转向。大局（逆势）：看空。
points_zh: 大局为看空（对日线多头而言属逆势）

ladder.liq_line_zh: 美国净流动性目前中性——对概率没有方向性影响。
ladder.age_line: ⏱ UNCONFIRMED TURN signal just triggered today (fresh cross from BUY ZONE). Signal strength: mild (score -25/100).
ladder.age_line_zh: ⏱ 未确认转向信号于今日刚刚触发（全新交叉，自买入区翻转）。 信号强度：温和（评分 -25/100）。
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：偏弱未确认转向（+30）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle low, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期低点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。
ladder.bc_line_zh: 日线 ✓ · 3日 ✓ · 周线 ✗ · 月线 ✗
ladder.bc_tip: Confidence this is a DURABLE, low-drawdown bottom: how near price is to the cycle low (the drawdown-depth axis) discounted when higher timeframes haven't confirmed the turn. Measured: weekly confirmation lifted the 'cycle-low held' rate ~19pp — a higher score held far more often. Risk/durability, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.bc_tip_zh: 衡量当前是否为「持久、低回撤」底部的信心：价格距周期低点的远近（回撤深度轴），并在更高周期尚未确认转向时打折。实测：周线确认使「周期低点守住」的比例提升约 19 个百分点——分数越高，低点守住的概率越大。这是风险/持久性，并非收益预测。

profile.description: Starbucks Corporation is an American multinational chain of coffeehouses and roastery reserves headquartered in Seattle, Washington. It was founded in 1971 by Jerry Baldwin, Zev Siegl, and Gordon Bowker at Seattle's Pike Place Market initially as a coffee bean wholesaler.
profile.description_zh: 星巴克公司是一家美国跨国连锁咖啡店和烘焙工坊企业，总部位于华盛顿州西雅图。它由杰瑞·鲍德温、泽夫·西格尔和戈登·鲍克于1971年在西雅图派克市场创立，最初是一家咖啡豆批发商。
